name: KSH–ingatlan.com rent index, asking rents (table annex)

measures.definition: Average monthly asking rent of flats advertised for rent in the half-year over their average floor area, times 50 m².
Average monthly asking rent of flats advertised for rent in the half-year over their average floor area, times 90 m².

rights.edition: KSH–ingatlan.com-lakbérindex, 2026. október, table annex (tablamelleklet.xlsx), tables 3 and 4, first half of 2026
rights.attribution: Forrás: KSH (www.ksh.hu), KSH–ingatlan.com-lakbérindex, CC BY 4.0 (edited: rate per m² times a flat size)

vetted.notes: Official experimental statistics: KSH computes them from ingatlan.com's listings under a cooperation agreement and publishes the tables as its own ("Forrás: KSH"). KSH's terms of use license all content on ksh.hu, tables included, under CC BY 4.0, with KSH named as the source and an active link; only datasets extracted on individual request are CC BY-NC. ingatlan.com's own listings are proprietary and are only linked. ksh.hu refuses plain HTTP clients, so the table annex is saved from a browser and passed to the fetcher.

caveats: Asking rents of flats on offer on one listings site (ingatlan.com), not rents agreed; KSH notes they differ markedly from what sitting tenants pay.

The rate per m² is the half-year's average rent over its average floor area (53 m² in Budapest); the three-bedroom figure is that rate times 90 m², an estimate rather than an average of three-bedroom listings.
